help:
Tracera CLI — manage the bundled/local Tracera Compose stack

Usage: tracera.exe [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  up       Start the Tracera Compose stack and wait until /ready
  down     Stop the Tracera Compose stack (containers stay on disk)
  status   Show container status (one row per service)
  logs     Tail logs from one or all services
  url      Print the local frontend URL and exit (used by the desktop app)
  backend  Print the resolved backend label and exit
  open     Open the local frontend in the default browser
  doctor   Health probe — exits 0 if /health and /ready both return ok
  init     Generate or refresh the `.env.local` file (POSTGRES_PASSWORD)
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --backend <BACKEND>
          Container runtime to use. Defaults to auto-detected best available.
          
          Choices: `docker`, `podman`, `apple-container`, `wsl+docker`.
          
          [env: TRACERA_BACKEND=]
          [possible values: docker, podman, apple-container, wsl+docker]

      --root <ROOT>
          Override the path to the Tracera bundle (or worktree root). Default: derived from the location of this binary
          
          [env: TRACERA_ROOT=]

  -v, --verbose...
          Increase verbosity (`-v` info, `-vv` debug, `-vvv` trace)

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version
